title: SmartAgri core: active, uncertainty-aware agronomic advisory
description:
Open core of an agronomic advisory system for maize. Before any text is generated, explicit deterministic layers decide whether the system may advise on a parcel at all: applicability of knowledge passages, quality of each input, sufficiency of the inputs, choice of the next question and a decision policy that recommends, gives a conditional answer, asks or abstains. Agronomic numbers are computed in code (FAO-56 ETc = Kc x ET0, a simplified root-zone balance, gross depth = net / efficiency); grounding checks keep a language model, when one is used, from adding unsupported numbers or sentences.

The repository includes BM25 retrieval with optional dense ranking, a web app, and an evaluation harness with an ablation ladder, blind rating, a leakage guard and a protocol lock. It runs offline without keys. Configuration values and the development corpus are defaults pending agronomic review; see docs/limitations.md in the archived release.
notes: Version, date and DOI are assigned by Zenodo from the GitHub release. CITATION.cff in the repository carries the same metadata.
